document: Requested qualification package v5, re-bound to narrowed supervisor v10; per-finding map from package-v4 review; NOEXEC
author: ContinueRQLS10b
naming: The v9-bound package-v5 drafts were snapshot-cited and are frozen unchanged. New child/config/checker file versions preserve that evidence while implementing the requested package-v5 binding to v10; QROOT is qual-pkg-v5-v10. Earlier plans remain immutable and unrun.

findings.title: no independent actual artifact integrity/binding
findings.disposition: Checker takes the parent's trusted approval SHA and ACTUAL supervisor exit as explicit external inputs. Approval pins exact config/GO/stability/preparation digests, four package source paths/digests and actual Python.app executable digest plus allocation totals. Checker independently reads/hashes those sources and files through no-follow anchored descriptors, reconstructs the exact scenario configuration, verifies launch/receipt/settlement/summary identities and digests, exact per-root inventory, same-inode .staged link with two links, required child output contents, current artifacts and supervisor expected digests. Launch mutation is precisely one appended b'x' verified against the original published digest. UNSETTLED bundles undergo the same checks. A self-consistent receipt dict is not trusted as an artifact hash.

findings.title: inexact outcomes / malformed JSON
findings.disposition: Exact expected failure-code sets, unique failure entries, ordered trip lists, rc/state/loop/signal/stop predicates, no hidden cancel/lost wait, exact end-pin statuses and cross-record representations. Strict decoder rejects duplicate keys, named nonfinite constants and overflow literals; numeric booleans fail typed predicates. Missing fields or malformed shapes produce FAIL, not a success-by-default. Current narrow scope replaces the prior fork/escape/helper expectations rather than claiming them passed.

findings.title: empty/incomplete samples and unproved intended causes
findings.disposition: Nonempty fully decoded strict JSON-value sequence, exact bytes/count/digest, complete typed census entries, monotonically ordered clocks, resource limits, reconciled maxima including clearance/final census, all-predicate clearance after stream close/reap, exact child identity/registry. Busy proves the ONE actual spinning child PID in sampled/trip busy sets; RSS proves the allocating child PID,320MiB touched and matching sampled threshold crossing; flood proves overflow/capture counters/file bytes/digest. Deadline validates its mono_spawn+wall bound. No zombie/escape proof is asserted: those children violate the narrowed single-process scope and have been removed.

findings.title: unconfined tool interfaces
findings.disposition: Fixed QROOT strictly inside the lane, no arbitrary base/output path. Writer validates semantics and source/interpreter pins before creation, opens through retained no-follow descriptors, requires a fresh scenario directory, and binds the qualification root with package-root.json. All invocation artifacts lie in RUN outside supervisor out/. Child accepts only scenario+lifetime, computes exact destinations and mutates only its own fixed fixture/launch file through retained directory descriptors with no create/no-follow/single-link checks. Checker output fixed as RUN/check.json exclusively. No prior-run file is changed.

findings.title: overstated lifetime/wall bounds
findings.disposition: GO is read with nonblocking os.read/select until an absolute deadline from module entry; partial input cannot block readline. Flood writes are nonblocking and deadline-checked, zero progress rejected. No descendant body exists, no exception-masking finally exit0. Interpreter startup is explicitly outside the module-entry bound and covered by the supervisor's independent deadline. Actual Python.app executable is mandatory to avoid launcher re-exec. Plan distinguishes nominal timing from native-call guarantees and pins parent gate/observer dependencies and artifact boundaries.

findings.title: allocation/release/later UNSETTLED disposition
findings.disposition: Each invocation gets a separate serialized parent allocation, exact approval digest and GO with current reservation totals and one CPU slot; no broad GO or automatic chain. The old busy2 test is removed (no authorized fork), replaced by one spinning process and TEST busy_limit0, cpu_slots1, global cap2 unchanged. Five-part release join: allocation+authorization; actual exit+captured summary+independent artifact hashes; checker; independent ended-owned identity census; entire-RUN late-artifact audit and a NEW exclusive parent disposition. Ignore/identity may write late output after supervisor return; checker records it and parent audits after verified end. UNSETTLED receipts remain immutable. No single file, exit, summary or PASS releases anything.

findings.title: stale checker identifier
findings.disposition: Checker reports guard_qual_check_v6, is pinned by actual SHA in the parent approval, and exits0 only for PASS,1 FAIL,2 infrastructure error.

removed_as_inapplicable: date_fault: no helper in v10 by explicit parent scope
busy2: fork violates single-process child contract
zombie_hold/escape_slow/escape_fast/double_fork_escape: not authorized single-process workloads; no runtime guarantee claimed for the fast fork+setsid residual
known_parent_blockers: All sources and controls remain unexecuted, no source acceptance/package acceptance/itemGO follows.

Static v10 integration caveat reported to parent: an earlier incomplete full_census retry's RSS/BUSY observation is discarded before caller limits are applied. Must be disposed in source review/correction before qualification.
Mixed real/effective UID metadata is strictly fail-closed. Persistent elevated login processes may prevent admission on this host; no silent exception was introduced.
Assay v7 and fixedb_q1_check_v5 remain held until final supervisor API is accepted; no numerical solver rework or Q1 run.
verification: AST parsing and static unresolved-name checks only for all new sources; the writer/checker's static config_for ASTs compare equal; test child contains no forbidden process-launch calls. No source module was imported/executed and no control was run.
